title: Abort was called at 435 line in file ./shared/source/os_interface/linux/drm_neo.cpp
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

The latest version of PyTorch for XPU is always leading to the below error. It is not happening with previous versions. Using Intel B60 card for inference.

Abort was called at 435 line in file:
./shared/source/os_interface/linux/drm_neo.cpp

Thread 1 "python" received signal SIGABRT, Aborted.
Download failed: Invalid argument.  Continuing without source file ./nptl/./nptl/pthread_kill.c.
__pthread_kill_implementation (no_tid=0, signo=6, threadid=<optimized out>) at ./nptl/pthread_kill.c:44
warning: 44     ./nptl/pthread_kill.c: No such file or directory

# Steps to recreate

# Source build F5_TTS
python3 -m venv f5_tts_env
source f5_tts_env/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu

git clone https://github.com/SWivid/F5-TTS.git
cd F5-TTS
git submodule update --init --recursive  # (optional, if use bigvgan as vocoder)
pip install -e .

# Install ffmpeg
sudo apt update
sudo apt install ffmpeg

# Run the python script
cd src/f5_tts/infer
python infer_cli.py
